comment.text: Placeholder of the text field for a suggestion's short label, the text shown on the clickable chip in the project's empty AI chat. Describes what to enter, noun phrase.

usage.context:
<div className={styles.suggestionHeader}>
 <TextInput
 type={InputType.text}
 value={row.name}
 onChange={(e) => updateSuggestion(row.key, { name: e.target.value })}
 placeholder={t("Common:AIProjectSuggestionLabelPlaceholder")}
 hasError={row.invalid && !row.name.trim()}
 isDisabled={isSaving}
 scale
 testId="ai-project-suggestion-name"
 />
